findings.currentPlan: Omgevingsplan gemeente Haaksbergen CVDR696197 remains the controlling address-specific source.
findings.currentVision: Omgevingsvisie gemeente Haaksbergen is current from 19-02-2026 and forms the strategic current environment layer.
findings.specificSplittingPolicy: Beleidskader Woningsplitsing bij inwoning buitengebied gemeente Haaksbergen CVDR703887 is current from 23-11-2023 and remains a positive municipality-specific rule for a narrow class: legal pre-existing inwoning situations in the buitengebied. It allows one existing dwelling to become at most two independent dwellings subject to conditions including legal uninterrupted pre-existing inwoning, no business dwelling, acceptable living environment, heritage protection where relevant, compliance with building rules, no increase of permitted main-building mass except potentially max 10% for building/quality reasons, and no impairment of surrounding functions/values.
findings.ordinaryRoomRentalAndOtherSplitting: No separate current municipality-wide generic ordinary room-rental or urban woningsplitsing policy was positively established in the targeted official-source sweep. Those outcomes remain address/current-plan dependent; no other-municipality rule is imported.
findings.applicationRoute: Omgevingsvergunning is filed digitally through Omgevingsloket. Municipality recommends a vooroverlegplan when feasibility is uncertain. Regular procedure is 8 weeks; extended procedure 6 months; one extension of max 6 weeks can apply.
findings.genericApplicationDocuments: Municipal building-application page requires at least a site plan of the property and a sketch/drawing clearly showing the intended development. Additional information can be requested. If environmental studies are needed the permit officer informs the applicant. Welstand is checked where applicable.
findings.houseNumberDocuments: If a separate house-number request is needed, submit a building-plan drawing at scale 1:1000 of old and new situation showing use area and purpose per room, plus owner consent if the applicant is a tenant. When an omgevingsvergunning is or will be filed, separate house-numbering is generally not needed because municipality handles it in that process.
findings.possibleStudies: Soil investigation is usually relevant for plan changes and building-permit applications; other environmental studies are project-dependent.
findings.fees: Legesverordening Haaksbergen 2026 CVDR753068 is current from 01-01-2026. The municipality states there is no single generic permit amount because applications may contain different activities; exact costs are activity-dependent. The 2025 leges regulation is expired and excluded.

quality.importantScopeRule: The buitengebied splitting policy is not generalized to all Haaksbergen dwellings; it applies to the defined pre-existing inwoning class.

remainingAllowedOnly: concrete-address/current Omgevingsplan outcome for ordinary room rental or splitting outside the specific buitengebied policy
